<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
matrix_exp(x) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Matrix exponential (scipy `linalg.expm` / torch semantics — numpy
has no `linalg.matrix_exp`).

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` of shape `(..., n, n)` (batched; the last two
  dims must be square).

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor` of the input's shape; dtype int/bool → float64, else preserved. The reference kernel is a pure-numpy scaling-and-squaring Taylor implementation (Higham 2005 family).

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `core.ShapeError` — rank < 2; statically non-square last two dims.
